description: This Java class provides methods for selecting/deleting documents in a MongoDB EventSource persistence, based on entity IDs and namespaces. It constructs query filters and manages collection selections.

classes.name: MongoPersistenceOperationsSelectionProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to generate selection queries for MongoDB based on entity IDs and namespaces for EventSource persistence.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of MongoPersistenceOperationsSelectionProvider with given settings.

methods.name: selectEntity
methods.description: Returns collection of selection objects for all occurrences of an entity by its ID.

methods.name: selectNamespace
methods.description: Returns collection of selection objects for all occurrences within a namespace.

methods.name: selectNamespaceByPid
methods.description: Creates a selection object for a namespace in a specific collection.

methods.name: filterByPidPrefix
methods.description: Creates a regex filter document for namespace prefix matching.

methods.name: selectEntityByPid
methods.description: Creates a selection object for an entity ID in a specific collection.

methods.name: filterByPid
methods.description: Creates a filter document for an entity ID.
